author: Beginnus
body:
Hello Staff,

I have been banned for almost seven full months.  I was banned for using kill aura. I am really sorry about any confusion or havoc I may have caused.  I know realize that I was wrong, and I promise never to use the hack again.  I am a good player and don't ever want to get banned again. avicus is a great server and I would really like to play on it again. Please consider unbanning me, I really would appreciate it.

Thank You for your time,
Beginnus
